The time when unit became active or started is printed after the "@" character.
The time the unit took to start is printed after the "+" character.

graphical.target @5.200s
└─multi-user.target @5.195s
  └─gdm.service @4.850s +345ms
    └─plymouth-quit.service @4.800s +45ms
      └─systemd-user-sessions.service @4.750s +48ms
        └─network.target @4.700s
          └─NetworkManager.service @4.350s +350ms
            └─basic.target @4.300s
              └─sockets.target @4.280s
                └─dbus.socket @4.250s +25ms
                  └─sysinit.target @4.200s
                    └─systemd-journald.service @3.850s +340ms
                      └─local-fs.target @3.800s
                        └─boot-efi.mount @3.650s +145ms
                          └─systemd-fsck@dev-disk-by\x2duuid-ubuntu.service @3.450s +195ms
                            └─dev-disk-by\x2duuid-ubuntu.device
